name: LineBalancingYamazumi
tagline: Balance assembly lines against takt – drag, check, suggest.
description: Yamazumi line balancing board for Power Apps and Power Pages: stacked work-element times per station against takt and target cycle, value-add / required non-value-add / waste analysis, precedence and zone rules, drag-and-drop, keyboard and list moves, auto-balance preview, undo, Kaizen view and line KPIs (cycle, efficiency, balance delay, smoothness, minimum stations, output per shift).
features: Yamazumi chart with takt and target lines
VA / NNVA / NVA colouring and category totals
Drag and drop (mouse, pen, touch) and Shift+Arrow keyboard moves
Precedence, zone and fixed-element rules (block or flag)
Suggest balance preview with before/after KPIs
Phone layout with horizontal Yamazumi cards
